skill.displayName: Frog Skin Moisture Assessment | 蛙类皮肤湿润度评估

llm.summary: The skill is a cloud-backed frog skin analysis tool, but it also silently creates or reuses an identity and stores account tokens locally, so it needs review before installation.

dimensions.detail: The implementation reads local media files, accepts http/https URLs for backend processing, reads workspace data/smyx-api-key.txt, creates workspace data directories, and writes a shared SQLite database; that environment reach is only partly disclosed and is heavier than a simple visual-assessment skill.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: The package is ordinary Python source with requirements for requests/SQLAlchemy/PyYAML/pydash and no separate installer found, but it bundles a large shared common library whose behavior is wider than the top-level skill.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: The skill documents automatic history queries and hidden identity handling, but it suppresses identity and API-key parameters from help and does not give users a clear control point before account-linked cloud access.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: The code creates or reuses a persistent local sys_user record and stores token/open_token fields in a SQLite database, with no clear user-facing retention, revocation, or isolation controls.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

dimensions.detail: Media upload and cloud report lookup are broadly aligned with the documented analysis/history features, but the bundled common code also performs silent login or registration and stores user/profile/token data, which is broader than the visible frog moisture assessment purpose.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

llm.guidance: Install only if you are comfortable with frog images/videos or URLs being sent to the configured Life Emergence cloud service and with the skill silently creating or reusing a local account identity. Review or clear the workspace data directory and local SQLite token store if you need account separation, and avoid using private/internal URLs as inputs.
llm.findings:
[LP3] unexpected: The scanner's least-privilege concern is supported in part: local file reading and network calls fit cloud media analysis, but generic API helpers plus local user/token persistence are broader and under-scoped.
[TP4] unexpected: Cloud history lookup is documented, but automatic identity provisioning, silent login/register behavior, and local token storage create a trust-boundary concern beyond the narrow frog assessment framing.
[SDI-2] unexpected: Verified hidden open-id handling, reading workspace data/smyx-api-key.txt, default identity creation/reuse, and account-scoped history retrieval; identity is useful for reports, but the fallback and token handling are not clearly user-controlled.
[SDI-1] expected: Submitting local files or URLs to an analysis backend is documented and expected for this cloud skill, though arbitrary URL/video handling is broader than the fixed-camera wording.
[SQP-2] expected: Attachment saving, file upload, and cloud history calls are described in the skill text, but users should still be warned that their media and report requests leave the local machine.
[SDI-4] unexpected: The hidden open-id parameter and comments saying identity is internal obscure who controls the identity value and how report access is scoped.
